description: Test suite for the Delivery Trip functionality in ERPNext, including setup, teardown, and various test cases for delivery trip statuses, route optimization, and related utility functions.

classes.name: TestDeliveryTrip
classes.description: Test case class for delivery trip functionalities, including status changes, route optimization, and notifications.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates driver, vehicle, contact, address, and delivery trip.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up database entries created during tests.

methods.name: test_expense_claim_fields_are_fetched_properly
methods.description: Verifies expense claim fields are correctly fetched.

methods.name: test_unoptimized_route_list_without_locks
methods.description: Checks route list generation without locks and optimization.

methods.name: test_unoptimized_route_list_with_locks
methods.description: Checks route list with locked stops without optimization.

methods.name: test_optimized_route_list_without_locks
methods.description: Checks route list with optimization when no stops are locked.

methods.name: test_optimized_route_list_with_locks
methods.description: Checks route list with optimization when stops are locked.

methods.name: test_delivery_trip_status_scheduled
methods.description: Verifies status after submitting the delivery trip.

methods.name: test_delivery_trip_status_cancelled
methods.description: Verifies status after cancelling the delivery trip.

methods.name: test_delivery_trip_status_in_transit
methods.description: Verifies status when delivery stops are visited.

methods.name: test_delivery_trip_status_completed
methods.description: Verifies status after completing all stops.
